MSIX for .NET 8+, Windows App SDK 1.6+; Windows 10 19041+ (App Installer auto-update: 1709+). WinUI 3 can package directly from `.csproj` with `WindowsPackageType`; WPF/WinForms use a Visual Studio Windows Application Packaging Project (`.wapproj`) referencing the app project. See [skill:dotnet-winui], [skill:dotnet-native-aot], [skill:dotnet-gha-patterns], [skill:dotnet-ado-patterns], [skill:dotnet-nuget-authoring], [skill:dotnet-containers], and [references/detailed-examples.md](references/detailed-examples.md).

All MSIX packages must be signed to install on Windows. The signing certificate's Subject must match the `Publisher` attribute in the package manifest. Store submissions are re-signed by Microsoft; no production signing certificate is needed for Store-only distribution. Use a trusted CA and timestamp for direct distribution.
